dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent closed-loop 'O' and open 'C' shaped structures with irregular, scalloped outer margins. Sharp gradient transition from low-intensity exterior background to high-intensity light perimeter is visible.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, high-intensity speckles concentrated along the dorsal ridge, exhibiting an asymmetrical, speckled distribution lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four largest macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an irregular quadrilateral with approximately equal spacing between the two most dorsal points.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct shift from high-contrast macro-annuli to a lower-contrast, stippled texture occurs moving from the mid-body towards the posterior area.
